etoro.period: Current calendar month to latest ranking refresh (MTD)
etoro.note: Public investors are a bounded discovery sample, not all eToro customers. Performance cohorts use MTD percentage return, not Hyperliquid lifetime dollar PnL. Direct-position allocation points weight portfolio percentages equally across accounts, not account dollars. Nested copy portfolios are not expanded because their allocation denominator is unspecified. Reported buy/sell holdings fields have no documented dollar-notional denominator.
